Over the FIRST HALF of the video, continuously untwist the head toward IMAGE RIGHT while lowering and closing the jaw, relax the bent shoulders and elbows, and place the near forepaw back into its ready support. The supplied final image is the target ready stance. Show every intermediate neck angle, jaw closure and foreleg adjustment gradually. Finish the recovery by the midpoint, then remain in the target posture with only slight settling.
